混合各風格路線八條，驗證適應力提升。: Climb eight problems in mixed styles to confirm your improved adaptability.
挑戰全新型態的路線。: Take on an entirely new type of route.
嘗試一條從未挑戰過類型的高難度路線。: Try one hard route of a type you have never attempted before.
恢復並回顧探索歷程。: Recover and look back on your exploration.
建立攀爬時的呼吸與身體覺察。: Build awareness of your breath and body while climbing.
緩慢攀爬簡單路線六條，全程配合呼吸，覺察每個重心轉移。: Climb six easy problems slowly, matching breath throughout and noticing every weight shift.
結合呼吸的伸展流程，每動作維持三十秒。: A breath-linked stretching routine, holding each position for 30 seconds.
練習連貫不停頓的流暢攀爬。: Practice smooth, continuous climbing without pauses.
完攀熟悉路線兩條，追求動作如流水般連貫不停滯。: Send two familiar routes, aiming for movement that flows like water without stalling.
平板撐與側棒各三組，培養穩定的身體控制。: Three sets each of planks and side planks to develop steady body control.
身心放鬆的恢復日。: A recovery day to relax body and mind.
緩慢深層伸展搭配冥想呼吸。: Slow, deep stretching with meditative breathing.
伏地挺身與肩推輕量平衡訓練。: Light push-up and shoulder-press balance training.
在每個動作中保持全然專注。: Stay fully focused in every single move.
攀爬中段難度路線六條，每個動作前先穩定呼吸再執行。: Climb six mid-grade problems, steadying your breath before executing each move.
前控與懸吊抬腿各三組，配合呼吸節奏。: Three sets each of front levers and hanging leg raises in rhythm with your breath.
在熟悉路線上追求心流狀態。: Seek a flow state on familiar routes.
反覆完攀熟悉路線，直到能完全進入心流不被雜念干擾。: Repeat familiar routes until you can enter flow completely, undisturbed by stray thoughts.
靜心攀爬六條，動作之間不急躁，享受過程。: Climb six problems with a quiet mind, unhurried between moves, enjoying the process.
在較高難度下維持冷靜與覺察。: Stay calm and aware at higher difficulty.
挑戰接近極限的路線，刻意在掙扎時維持呼吸節奏。: Attempt near-limit problems and deliberately keep your breathing rhythm while struggling.
懸體支撐與側棒各三組，培養壓力下的穩定。: Three sets each of L-sits and side planks to develop stability under pressure.
在挑戰性路線上維持流暢與專注。: Stay smooth and focused on challenging routes.
挑戰高一級路線，面對墜落恐懼時專注於呼吸與動作。: Attempt a route one grade higher, focusing on breath and movement when the fear of falling arises.
完整的身心恢復。: Complete recovery for body and mind.
統合技巧、呼吸與專注。: Bring technique, breath and focus together.
完攀各難度路線八條，全程保持呼吸與動作的和諧。: Send eight problems across grades, keeping breath and movement in harmony throughout.
綜合核心循環兩輪，配合呼吸。: Two rounds of a full core circuit, in time with your breath.
在挑戰中驗證身心平衡成果。: Verify your mind-body balance under challenge.
挑戰高難度路線，全程維持心流與冷靜。: Attempt a hard route, staying in flow and calm from start to finish.
身心沉澱並回顧歷程。: Let body and mind settle and look back on the journey.
